key_insight: The paper accelerates multiscale PDE surrogate construction by interpolating parameter-dependent local reduced spaces on the Grassmann manifold, rather than recomputing them from scratch.
engineering_relevance: This enables efficient, scalable reduced-order modeling for heterogeneous engineering PDEs with many parameters, while preserving the accuracy benefits of MS-GFEM.
method: Decompose the global multiscale PDE into localized parameter-dependent subproblems.
Represent each optimal local approximation space as a point on the Grassmann manifold.
Use sparse-grid Grassmann interpolation to approximate these local subspaces efficiently in high-dimensional parameter spaces.
evidence_signal: Numerical experiments on elliptic problems verify the predicted convergence behavior, matching the method’s near-exponential spatial and sparse-grid parametric rates.
watch_item: The approach assumes local parameter dependence and relies on accurate interpolation of subspaces, so performance may degrade if parameters are strongly nonlocal or sparse-grid coverage is insufficient.
paper_title: Efficient localised model reduction for multiscale PDEs via Grassmannian interpolation
